title: Operator dynamics in k-Markov random circuits
summary: We demonstrate that $k$-Markov sequences of unitary gates provide low-cost handles to manipulate the rate and structure of information spreading compared to traditional random, 0-Markov, circuits. For SWAP gates and brickwork circuits, we use graph cover time to demonstrate how $k$-Markov processes can be used to control operator transport. With SWAP gates and the set of Clifford gates that can change operator weight, we show how $k$-Markov sequences can be used to manipulate scrambling time and generate novel structures of spatial-temporal correlations across a qubit network.
